verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page names a 'Weighted pipeline' report alongside win rate and stage conversion metrics. It also offers live-data charts over a native Deal object, so pipeline-value weighting appears to be a first-party capability. The evidence is only marketing-level labels, with nothing on how weighting or forecasting is actually computed. Missing for 10: documented per-stage probability configuration, close-date-based forecast projections, revenue forecast report documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
